name: Calibre
tagline: A powerful and easy to use e-book manager. Users say it's outstanding and a must-have. It'll allow you to do nearly everything and it takes things a step beyond normal e-book software. It's also completely free and open source and great for both casual users and computer experts.
description: Calibre is a powerful and easy to use e-book manager. Users say it's outstanding and a must-have. It'll allow you to do nearly everything and it takes things a step beyond normal e-book software. It's also completely free and open source and great for both casual users and computer experts.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/calibre:9.17.0@sha256:b198fc03a6abc6be7e251a9958e50e74634b00e447c7b25e92c191c8077ba378
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
      CUSTOM_USER: $CUSTOM_USER
      PASSWORD: $PASSWORD
      CLI_ARGS: ''
    ports:
      - target: 8080
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 8181
        published: 8181
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 8081
        published: 8081
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
